items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Ray Cricera, Carnival of Venice, I did Saxophobia

ctx.x: And that can't be obtained at all?

Becquard? Oh, God, no. You see, sometimes we miss out on ourselves. I could buy the records at that time at distributors' price, $2.19, but who thought of buying two, three hundred albums? The same way with Columbia. You think, oh, I'll wait until next month. By that time they're gone. The company goes broke. Now this has been going on, Howard, in the record industry for years. Bernie Green, who conducted the Sid Caesar Show, he is a tremendous composer. This man has ideas. He can write anything. Spike Jonze…
